quant_strategy.policy: Prefer first-party or established mlx-community checkpoints already optimized for Apple/MLX, pinned by immutable revision. Where no suitable MLX checkpoint exists, convert from the original model source (never from GGUF) with a reproducible, Mei-owned conversion command that records bits, group size, calibration/data choices, and revision. Choose per-model bit depth by weight size, long-context/KV-cache headroom, tool reliability, and measured speed; start memory-safe at 4-bit for 26-35B models and test 5-bit or higher only when the memory gate leaves headroom. Do not force the same bit depth or recipe across architectures. Gemma and Qwen3.5/Qwen3.8 image-text-to-text (VLM) checkpoints carry preprocessor/processor files; the architecture-specific load/template/tool-call path is added only when required by evidence.
quant_strategy.publication_policy: For every Mei-produced model artifact intended for end users, publish the complete model directory to a dedicated public Hugging Face model repository with a self-contained README model card and sanitized conversion-provenance.json. Record hf_repository, hf_url, hf_revision, model_card, and provenance_file on the corresponding lineup entry. Keep third-party artifacts linked to their upstream repositories and do not imply that their provenance is Mei-produced.
